Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Pithiviers
notes: Restricted use: home-based aircraft and aircraft based on neighbouring aerodromes only.
Traffic-pattern training reserved for home-based aircraft.
Take-off runway 07: turn left as soon as possible to avoid overflying the village.
No holding-point signs or marks before the runway; taxiing prohibited except on runway and taxiway.
With north or south crosswind, turbulence possible on approach and on the runway.
Aerobatics (NR 6403) overhead the runway, 1700-3500 ft AMSL, prohibited if QNH is below 1009 hPa.
